sloka: धर्षयित्वा हृता सा तु सुप्ताप्यन्तःपुरे तव ।श्रुत्वा ऽपि तन्महाराज क्षान्तमेव हतो न सः ।। ७.२५.२७ ॥
transliteration: dharṣayitvā hṛtā sā tu suptāpyantaḥpure tava ।śrutvā 'pi tanmahārāja kṣāntameva hato na saḥ ।। 7.25.27 ॥

translations.english: She was abducted after being violated, even while sleeping in your inner chambers, yet, O great king, even after hearing of that, he was indeed forgiven and not killed.
